name: Cymbal Retail Operations Agent - Multi-Turn Conversation Suite
description: Multi-turn conversational scenarios exercising context retention, hard intent switching across the three analytical gateways, and sequential federated audit chains. Graded exclusively with multi_turn_* managed metrics: single-turn judges reject agent_eval_data carrying >1 turn (400 INVALID_ARGUMENT), so this suite is isolated from eval-data.json.

eval_cases.description: Context retention: turn 2 says 'that cashier' with no id. The agent must carry STORE_048#CASH_1190 forward from turn 1 and switch from the alert tool to read_pos_transactions_enriched_sql -- never re-ask for the id.
